Talents.Name: Spectral Barrier
Text: Power: 1x Intuition
The barrier is always exactly 1 inch thick.
The barrier blocks physical matter, sound and other psychic effects, and magic.
The barrier may not be placed through any creature, and it may not push against any non-ally creature.
Shell:
Target: Unit or point within 20 feet Range.
Create a shell which encapsulates the point in a perfect sphere.
The shell’s maximum diameter is 10 feet in any direction.
Plane:
Target: Unit or point within 20 feet Range.
Create a wall (or plane) barrier extending from the chosen point.
This plane can be of any two-dimensional shape, but must be flat.
The plane’s maximum diameter is 10 feet in any direction.

Talents.Name: Freeflowing Arts
Text: Your barrier can now deal damage when moving.
Aspect: Sharp (Piercing, Slashing, Chopping) or Blunt (Pummeling, Smashing, Impact)
Augment the barrier to be able to cut through things or deal damage when moving. The barrier can be made to be thinner or thicker.

Talents.Name: Split Concentration
Text: You can make multiple barriers at the same time.

Talents.Name: Permeable Barrier
Text: Augment the barrier to be permeable to either Physical, Magical, or Mental types.

Talents.Name: Phantasmal Weapon
Text: Turn your barrier directly into a weapon.

Talents.Name: Gravity
Text: The direction and force of gravity bends to your will and changes to what you would prefer until the beginning of your next turn.
AoE: Entire room, or 160 feet (40 tiles). Centered upon you.
Extend (12 Energy): At the beginning of your turn, when the effect would end, you may instead pay the cost to extend the duration until the beginning of your next turn.
